privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: This page explains what Viking Store collects when you browse, create an account, place an order, contact support, or use store features.

sections.title: Information we collect
body: When you create an account or verify your email, we use Supabase Auth and may store profile details such as your name, email, phone, gender, address, city, country, postal code, bio, and avatar.

When you place an order, we collect the details needed to process it, including cart items, selected sizes or colors, delivery/contact details, notes, coupon information when used, payment method, and order status.
When you submit a product review, we store the product, your user ID, rating, comment, and review timestamps. Public review displays do not expose your email address.

sections.title: How we use information
body: We use this information to run the store, create and manage accounts, process orders, support guest and authenticated checkout, show order history, handle reviews, and respond to support requests.
Product prices and order totals are handled in EGP. Cash on delivery is currently part of the checkout flow.

sections.title: Storage and service providers
body: Viking Store uses Supabase for authentication, profile data, order data, product data, reviews, and uploaded images where applicable.
The browser may store essential local data such as cart items, wishlist items, pending registration profile details during OTP verification, and the viking_locale language preference cookie.
We did not identify advertising pixels or analytics trackers in the current storefront code. If those services are added later, this policy should be updated.

sections.title: Sharing
body: We do not sell customer personal information.
We may share only the information needed with providers that help operate the store, such as hosting, database, authentication, storage, delivery, support, or legal/compliance services.

sections.title: Security and your choices
body: We use reasonable technical controls for account and order handling, but no online system can be guaranteed to be completely secure.
You can update your profile from your account, clear browser storage for local cart/wishlist/language data, or contact Viking Store support to ask about your account or order information.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.lead: These terms explain the basic rules for using Viking Store, browsing products, creating an account, and placing orders.

sections.title: Using the store
body: You may browse Viking Store as a guest. Some features, such as saved profile details, order history, and writing product reviews, require an authenticated account.
You are responsible for providing accurate account, delivery, and contact information when using the store.

sections.title: Products, pricing, and availability
body: Product information, images, stock, categories, sizes, colors, prices, and sale prices are shown from the store catalog and may change over time.
Prices are stored and displayed in EGP. A product being visible in the store does not guarantee availability until the order is reviewed or processed.

sections.title: Orders and payment
body: Checkout supports guest orders and authenticated account orders. The secure order flow recalculates product totals and coupon discounts on the server side before an order is created.
Cash on delivery is currently supported in checkout. Payment status, order status, shipping details, and order items are recorded with the order.

sections.title: Coupons, shipping, and returns
body: Coupons, when available, are validated against their active dates, limits, product/category restrictions, and order requirements.

Shipping and return handling should be confirmed through Viking Store support or the FAQ. This page does not set fixed delivery fees, delivery timelines, or return periods beyond what is already shown elsewhere on the site.

sections.title: Reviews and content
body: Authenticated users may submit one review per product. Reviews should be honest, relevant, and not abusive or misleading.
Viking Store may remove content that breaks store rules, creates operational issues, or is legally unsafe.

sections.title: Changes and contact
body: We may update these terms as the store changes. Continued use of Viking Store means you accept the current version.
For questions about orders, products, returns, or these terms, contact Viking Store through the support details shown on the site.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.lead: This page explains the cookies and browser storage Viking Store uses for core store behavior and preferences.

sections.title: What cookies and local storage are
body: Cookies and browser storage help the site remember essential information in your browser, such as language, cart state, wishlist state, and account/session behavior.
Some storage is required for the store to work correctly. Disabling it may affect login, checkout, cart, wishlist, or language preference behavior.

sections.title: Essential store storage
body: Supabase Auth manages authentication/session behavior for account login, registration, OTP verification, and protected account features.
The cart and wishlist are saved locally in your browser so your selected gear can stay available between page visits.
During email OTP registration, pending profile information is kept temporarily in browser storage until profile persistence succeeds.

sections.title: Preferences
body: The viking_locale cookie stores your selected language so Arabic or English stays active after refreshes and future visits.
Theme or color-mode preferences may also be stored by the site UI where applicable.

sections.title: Analytics and advertising
body: The current storefront code does not include confirmed advertising pixels or analytics trackers such as Google Analytics or Meta Pixel.
If analytics or advertising tools are added later, this policy should be updated to explain what is used and why.

sections.title: Managing browser storage
body: You can clear cookies and site data from your browser settings. Clearing storage may sign you out and remove local cart, wishlist, or language preferences.
For questions about site storage, contact Viking Store through the support details shown on the site.
